remarks: Nestled on a picturesque cul-de-sac in the heart of Silvermine, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home sits on a private one-acre lot surrounded by natural beauty. A brand-new bluestone pathway welcomes you to the front door. Inside, the main level boasts soaring ceilings, creating an airy, open ambiance. The living room with a gas fireplace flows seamlessly into the dining room, which opens to an expansive deck, perfect for entertaining. The eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring granite countertops, a Wolfe range, warming drawer, double wall convection oven, Asko dishwasher, skylights, and elegant copper sinks, including a farmhouse sink and a bar sink on the island. Pocket doors provide the option for privacy when needed. The upper level features three bedrooms and two full baths, including a spacious primary suite with its own private deck, a newly renovated spa-like bathroom with a steam shower, heated towel rack, and dressing room. The lower level offers a cozy family room, a fourth bedroom, a full bath, a laundry room, and walk-out access to the fenced backyard-ideal for pets, play, or relaxation. You'll love the added perks of a whole-house Sonos system, a 2-car garage, and a whole-house generator for peace of mind. Just moments away from the Silvermine Arts Center, the Inn at GrayBarns, and all the charm of Historic Silvermine, this home offers both privacy and convenience in one of the area's most sought-after neighborhoods.
